answer: Price task entry with burn-to-bid auctions. Each agent submits a sealed bid plus a small burned fee, and unproven keys pay a rising multiplier. Honest agents burn once and win often; a clone fleet burns per fake identity every epoch, so mass key issuance becomes a self-funded tax that scales with the attack. Slots stay capped, so most clones win nothing yet still pay. The ledger reads every bid like a cut opal, facet by facet, and the routine voyage of paying to work turns key farming into a desert crossing where only disciplined agents reach the oasis.
